title: TopologyV2Drilldown
description: A contextual action or navigation option returned by resolve (e.g., expand ports, switch to another view). Drilldowns are evaluated client-side via appliesWhen and then resolved by calling the target view's resolve API with a merged request built from the current request + drilldown static/dynamic patches.

viewId.description: Target viewId to resolve if this drilldown is chosen.

mode.description: How the UI should apply the resolved result. "replace" navigates/replaces the current graph; "overlay" merges the resolved graph onto the current canvas (keyed by overlayKey when provided).

appliesWhen.description: Optional match predicate evaluated client-side against current context or selected node/edge labels.

static.description: Literal (hardcoded) request overrides/params applied when this drilldown is invoked.

dynamic.description: Client-evaluated request overrides/params applied when this drilldown is invoked. Dynamic values may reference an evaluation context provided by the UI (typically: node, edge, request).
